title: Get a Life, Chloe Brown
author: Talia Hibbert
summary: After a close call, a woman who lives with chronic pain writes a list of things to do to start really living. Her building's handyman, an artist with his own wounds, becomes her unlikely guide through it.
readIf: you like witty, tender romance with a prickly heroine, a gentle hero and real attention to chronic illness.
skipIf: you want a story that stays entirely on the surface, as past hurts are discussed honestly.

pairings.reason: Both are warm contemporary romances with leads who are treated as whole, funny, capable people.
Another cosy, character-first romance where old hurts are slowly worked through with kindness.
A prickly, bookish heroine who is thawed by a charming man, set in a more magical world.
